name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Forbidden Fruit
description: Step into pure tropical indulgence with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Forbidden Fruit, a flavor-packed indica hybrid that blends intense relaxation with mouthwatering fruitiness. Designed for easy application, this precision brush lets you infuse dabs, prerolls, blunts, or glassware with potent, terpene-rich live resin. With sweet cherry, tropical citrus, and deep earthy undertones, Forbidden Fruit delivers an instant euphoric uplift, quickly followed by full-body relaxation and stress relief. Ideal for evening unwinding or vibing out, this strain hits smooth and finishes strong.
